from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess
root=Path("/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave16")
raw=root/"out/fs-w16-dense1024-nki-norm-device-micro-r1/rank0"
staged=root/"out/fs-w16-dense-norm-ingest-input-r2"
staged.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
for src in raw.rglob("*"):
 if src.is_file():
  dst=staged/src.relative_to(raw);dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);os.link(src,dst)
for ntff in staged.rglob("*.ntff"):
 for src in (raw/"neffs").glob("*.neff"):
  os.link(src,ntff.parent/("compiled_"+src.name))
print("Staged original capture plus exported compiled NEFFs beside each NTFF",flush=True)
p=subprocess.run(["/opt/aws/neuron/bin/neuron-explorer","view","--session-dir",str(staged),"--data-path",str(root/"out/fresh-start-explorer"),"--display-name","dense1024-nki-norm-device-micro-r2-complete","--ingest-only"])
raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
